Interface RequestVisitor<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the context type passed alongside the request (typically VirtualClient on the server side)
All Known Implementing Classes:
ActionExecutionState, ControllerState, EndGameState, EndRoundState, EventsState, ExtraMoveState, InitGameState, LobbyState, RecoverState, ServerController, TotemPickingState, TotemPlacementState
public interface RequestVisitor<T>
Visitor interface for dispatching ClientRequest subtypes without instanceof checks. Implemented by ControllerState (game-phase dispatch) and ServerController (lobby-level dispatch).
